kodi-validation.description: Static disposable add-on validation without Kodi Lab
kodi-validation.prompt: Load kodi-addon-validation, discover the actual fixture root, run static checks for the explicitly requested release, and summarize evidence and limits.

kodi-review.description: Contextual review with canonical checker composition
kodi-review.prompt: Load kodi-addon-validation, get numbered context, then compose a short evidence-backed draft. Empty findings are valid. Do not promote uncertain observations to errors.
